policy_source.source: LimX Dynamics tron1-rl-deploy-python, WF_TRON1A isaacgym policy

adapter.policy_io: metalsim/tron1/limx_policy.py (port of LimX's controllers/WheelfootController.py at 035e4c9): 28 observations, 10-frame history -> encoder.onnx (3), then policy.onnx on [encoder 3, obs 28, commands x (2, 2, 0.25)] -> 8 actions at 50 Hz; legs q = 0.25 a, Kp 42 / Kd 2.5; wheels dq = 0.8 a via Kd 0.8; LimX's torque-bound action clips (80 / 40 N m)
adapter.physics: metalsim.tron1.sim.Tron1Sim on CPU MuJoCo 3.14.0 (LimX's WF_TRON1A MJCF, physics step 0.5 ms) with MetalSim's TRON1 realism layer at 'nominal' (metalsim.tron1.realism.SimParams.nominal()); controller 500 Hz, policy 50 Hz; one Tron1Sim per env, seeds 0..15
adapter.procedure: each robot placed on its wheels with straight legs (LimxPolicyController.initial_q, q = 0), then 3 s standing under the policy at the schedule's first command before the film's t = 0; every command change ramped linearly over 0.5 s from the previous command
adapter.actions: LimX's policy output (deterministic); noise from each env's Tron1Sim seed
adapter.done: Tron1Sim's fall check (tilt > 70 deg, or base / sensor pack / leg link touching the ground); no time-out

tracking.definition: evaluate.episode's metrics at one sample per film frame (20 ms; the evaluation samples every 10 ms): vx = base forward speed in the heading frame, wz = base yaw rate (Tron1Sim.truth); errors are measured minus the command sent (the schedule, each change ramped over ramp_s; complete on every frame the RMS counts); RMS over frames at least 0.5 s after the last command change and before a fall; pitch / roll peaks of |angle| before a fall; fall = Tron1Sim's fall check (tilt > 70 deg, or base / sensor pack / leg link on the ground). Times are film times, after the pre-roll (pre_roll_s), which no metric includes. Summary: medians, maxima and 95th percentiles over envs that did not fall.
